title: Write Facebook ad copy with AI that people believe
seoTitle: Facebook ad copy with AI: a step-by-step guide
description: Write Facebook ad copy with AI from real product facts and buyer words. Get the job of each ad part, hook styles, Meta's rules and prompts to copy.
lede: To write Facebook ad copy with AI that people believe, start with your real product facts and your customers' own words. This guide shows how to turn them into one reason to buy, ten hooks and a complete ad in Meta's three text parts. It also includes copy-ready prompts, a real example and a policy checklist.
